item.name: Bank AGI (UAT)
item.description: Bank AGI UAT samples. Read BankAGI_UAT_README.md before testing. Requires configured sandbox credentials and bank fixtures. Signing resolves the wire URL/body/token; refreshes timestamps per request. Negative signature/timestamp cases are deliberate. Duplicate external-ID rejection is not implemented in backend. Do not run the whole folder blindly: setup creates repositories; notify changes orders and can dispatch merchant callbacks.

request.description: **Expected**: `2007300 Successful`. Stores `agi_access_token` and `agi_timestamp` for the next requests.

**Scenario 1 - Any Service - Access Token Invalid.**

**Expected**: HTTP 401 `4011901` `Invalid Token (B2B)`.

_Note_: SNAP spec wording is "Access Token Invalid"; the middleware returns `4011901 Invalid Token (B2B)` for unknown/expired tokens and `4011903 Token Not Found (B2B)` when the Authorization header is missing. Capture either as evidence.
**Expected**: HTTP 401 `4011903` `Token Not Found (B2B)`.

**Scenario 2 - Any Service - Unauthorized Signature.**

**Expected**: HTTP 401 `4011900` `Unauthorized [Signature]`.

Signature is computed normally then deliberately corrupted.

**Scenario 3 - Any Service - Missing Mandatory Field.**

Body omits `additionalInfo.merchantUser` and `additionalInfo.billNumber`.

**Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001902` `Invalid Mandatory Field [additionalInfo.merchantUser]`.

**Scenario 4 - Any Service - Invalid Field Format.**

`latestTransactionStatus` = `99` (not in allowed enum `00..07`).

**Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001901` `Invalid Field Format [latestTransactionStatus]`.

item.name: 5b. Invalid Field Format - Non JSON body (4001901)

request.description: **Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001901` `Invalid Field Format [body]` (body rejected before signature check).
**Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001901` `Invalid Field Format [X-TIMESTAMP]`.
**Expected**: HTTP 401 `4011900` `Unauthorized [Timestamp expired]`. Timestamp older than 300s.

**Scenario 5 - Any Service - Cannot use the same X-EXTERNAL-ID.**

1. Send **11. Payment Notify - Success** once (or any valid notify) and note its `X-EXTERNAL-ID`.
2. Set `agi_external_id` to that same value and resend within the cache window.

**Expected**: HTTP 409 `4091900` `Conflict`.

⚠️ Local middleware currently does **not** de-duplicate `X-EXTERNAL-ID`. If empty/200 is returned, raise it with the backend owner before UAT sign-off.

**Scenario 6 - QR MPM Generate QR - Show QR Code.**

**Expected**: `2001700 success` with `qr_string` + `result.qrContent`.

Auto-stores `agi_reference`, `agi_bill_number`, `agi_qr_string`, `agi_amount`, `agi_merchant_id`, `agi_merchant_user`, `agi_payment_repository_id` for the notify steps.

**Scenario 7 - QR MPM Generate QR - Invalid Merchant.**

**Expected**: merchant API returns error with code `4041708` `Invalid Merchant` from AGI.

To reproduce: point `agi_invalid_repository_id` at a repository whose `merchant_id` is not registered at AGI (or edit `merchant_id` in the repo config first).

**Scenario 14 - Generate QR Melebihi batas maksimal nominal > 10.000.000.**

**Expected**: rejected by AGI (validation error from bank, e.g. `4001701` / `Invalid Amount`). Capture the bank response body.

**Scenario 8 - QR MPM Generate QR - QR Expired.**

Creates a QR with `expiryPeriod = 1` minute. Wait > 1 minute, then run **13. Check Status - Invalid Bill Number** / **15. Query Payment - Expired** to evidence `4041801 Transaction Expired/Transaction Not Found`.

**Scenario 9 - Query Payment - Pending Transaction.**

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Not Found` (ON US sheet) — AGI returns "not found" until paid.

Uses `agi_reference` from step 7.

**Scenario 10 - Query Payment - Failed Transaction.**

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Not Found`.

⚠️ The `status` filter is a **local** middleware helper; AGI itself has no "fail" query param. For bank-side evidence, capture the notify with `latestTransactionStatus = 05` (see **12c**).

**Scenario 12 - Query Payment - Success Transaction.**

**Expected**: order `status = SUCCESS` after step 11.

**Scenario 11 - Payment Notify - Notify Success.**

**Expected**: HTTP 200 `2001900 Success`; order status becomes `SUCCESS`.

Run **7** first so `agi_bill_number` / `agi_reference` are populated. Re-running is idempotent (still `2001900`).
**Expected**: HTTP 200 `2001900 Success` even though order is already `SUCCESS` (idempotency guard).
**Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001901 Invalid Field Format [amount]` (amount differs from original order).

**Expected**: HTTP 200 `2001900 Success`; order status becomes `FAILED`.

Use this as the "failed transaction" evidence for scenario 10.

**Scenario 13 - Check Status - Invalid Bill Number.**

Set `agi_invalid_reference` to e.g. `AGI-UAT-NOT-EXISTS-999`.

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Not Found`.

BLOCKER: This request tests a missing LOCAL reference, not an invalid bank bill number. It cannot evidence bank code 4041801.
**Expected**: HTTP 404 `4041901 Transaction Not Found`. Sets `agi_invalid_bill_number` to `7000000000000000009999999` by default.

**Scenario 15 - Saldo Rekening Pembayaran kurang dari jumlah nominal transaksi.**

Create a small QR (Rp 1.000), then attempt payment from an AGI test account with lower balance.

**Expected**: notify `latestTransactionStatus = 05` with a failure reason; middleware replies `2001900 Success` and order becomes `FAILED`. Capture both bank and middleware responses.

**Scenario 16 - Payment menggunakan Rekening Dormant.**

Pay QR from a dormant AGI account, then query.

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Not Found` (payment never settles).

item.name: 03 - QR MPM OFF US (13 scenarios)
item.description: Sheets: `QR MPM (Off Us)` — 13 scenarios. Differences vs ON US: pending query returns `4042116 PENDING`.

request.description:
**Scenario 6 - QR MPM Generate QR - Show QR Code (OFF US).**

**Expected**: `2001700 success`.

**Scenario 7 - Invalid Merchant.**

**Expected**: code `4041708 Invalid Merchant`.

**Scenario 8 - QR Expired.** Create with `expiryPeriod=1`, wait > 1 minute, then query.

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Expired/Transaction Not Found`.

**Scenario 9 - Query Payment - Pending (OFF US only).**

**Expected**: `4042116 PENDING`.

⚠️ Off Us pending is bank-side behaviour. Middleware keeps order `PENDING`; to evidence the `4042116 PENDING` response capture the direct AGI query response.

**Scenario 10 - Query Payment - Failed (OFF US).**

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Not Found`.

**Scenario 11 - Payment Notify - Notify Success (OFF US).**

**Expected**: `2001900 Success`; order -> `SUCCESS`.

**Scenario 12 - Query Payment - Success (OFF US).**

**Expected**: order `status = SUCCESS`.

**Scenario 13 - Check Status - Invalid Bill Number.**

**Expected**: `4041801 Transaction Not Found`.

BLOCKER: This request tests a missing LOCAL reference, not an invalid bank bill number. It cannot evidence bank code 4041801.
**Expected**: HTTP 401 `4011903 Token Not Found (B2B)`.
**Expected**: HTTP 401 `4011900 Unauthorized [Signature]`.
**Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001902 Invalid Mandatory Field [additionalInfo]`.
**Expected**: HTTP 400 `4001901 Invalid Field Format [amount.currency]`.

**Expected**: HTTP 409 `4091900 Conflict` when the same `X-EXTERNAL-ID` is reused.

⚠️ Not yet enforced in local middleware — see note on ON US scenario 5.
